name: Gruv
tagline: A money companion built for how young Sri Lankans actually live.

lines: Sri Lanka has no open banking.
So I built a finance app that reads your bank SMS.

scenes.title: Balances derived from every transaction.
scenes.sub: Imports that go wrong can be reversed, not reconciled by hand.

scenes.title: SMS parsing + on-device statement OCR.
scenes.sub: Bank statements never leave the phone.

scenes.title: An AI companion, not a guilt machine.
scenes.sub: Insights are real arithmetic on your ledger. The LLM just talks.

scenes.title: Family is a top-level category.
scenes.sub: Sinhala, Tamil and English from day one.

scenes.line: Designed + built solo by Senul Mapa
